inputs.description: Tensor of rank 4. Input tensor of shape: - If `data_format="channels_last"`: `(batch_size, height, width, channels)`. - If `data_format="channels_first"`: `(batch_size, channels, height, width)`.

output_size.description: Integer or tuple/list of 2 integers, specifying the target output spatial dimensions `(output_height, output_width)`. If a single integer is provided, the same value is used for both dimensions.

data_format.description: string, either `"channels_last"` or `"channels_first"`. Defaults to the value found in your Keras config file at `~/.keras/keras.json`. If never set, defaults to `"channels_last"`.
constraints: data_format must be one of channels_last, channels_first

output.description: A tensor of rank 4 representing the adaptive max pooled result.
